title: Diodes and transistors
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: The diode and the transistor are both made of semiconductor material.
lines.label: semiconductor

lines.caption: A diode lets current flow in only one direction.
lines.label: diode

lines.caption: Its two ends are the anode and the cathode. A stripe on the package marks the cathode.
lines.label: anode and cathode

lines.caption: A light-emitting diode, or LED, gives off light when forward current flows through it.
lines.say: A light emitting diode, or L E D, gives off light when forward current flows through it.
lines.label: LED

lines.caption: A transistor uses a small signal to control a larger current. It can work as an electronic switch.
lines.label: transistor

lines.caption: It can also amplify. Gain tells you how much larger the output is than the input.
lines.label: gain
